Definition: A set of rules that decides where each item in a container goes and how big it is.
An item that holds other items, such as a page, a grouping, or a game window.
One dot on the screen. A size in pixels stays the same, no matter how big the window is.
A size or position given as a part of the container, from 0.0 (none of it) to 1.0 (all of it).
The point on a control that is placed at its x and y position. An origin of 0.5, 0.5 is the control's center.
A rule for how a control works out its width or height, such as STANDARD, FILL or FIT_CONTENTS.
An object that stores how one control should be positioned and sized.
An arrangement of equal-sized cells in rows and columns.
When one control covers more than one cell of a grid.
Designing an interface so that it changes its arrangement to fit the screen or window it is shown in.
